settings.choose_ask_to_undo_a: Choose Ask to undo a previous auto-allow
settings.if_proxy_crashes_or_license: If proxy crashes or license lapses
settings.block_is_safer_allow_keeps: Block is safer; Allow keeps working but may overspend

settings.legend_monitor_only: Monitor only: plans, Cursor and other unproxied or non-blocking traffic. No line; alerts only, never stops.
